questions.question: Seven persons, K, L, M, N, O, P and Q, are sitting in a row facing towards the north. K and M are sitting together. O is at the east-end. P is between Q and M. Q is sitting in the middle. N is between O and L. K is sitting at the west-end. Who is sitting at the fifth position from the east?
questions.solution:
Seven persons, K, L, M, N, O, P and Q, are sitting in a row facing towards the north.

1) O is at the east-end and N is between O and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/059148e5f29ba990b00edf0c5c67826f53161c2567a324efc4eff6d6bb65c40c.png] 

2) K is sitting at the west-end and K and M are sitting together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/841d209af8d71a75ddc14676055e54d2d3dbe48c4d2e4f4347503cdbe5cfb13d.png] 

3) P is between Q and M and Q is sitting in the middle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b181fbf3691e4844e95af0d3e1684fa0ca06d29a256d71cf79bab2b09479e2.png] 

∴ Here, 'P' is sitting fifth position from east.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**

questions.question: Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. Only two people sit to the right of U. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only two people sit between U and Q. Only three people sit between R and V. T is not an immediate neighbour of U. S sits to the right of U. Who sits to the immediate right of U?
questions.solution:
Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U, and V, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north

Step 1: Only two people sit to the right of U.

Step 2: Only two people sit to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/932d5fcf91727b8748d28a7dd8f2294d58dbf135476f5487184c339ec1ee64bf.png]

Step 5: T is not an immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1d0a2da0fb3dc7d5fa37dd4b010ee1e0a2eae2a2fd1bdb4ec6e14db8445a714.png] 

According to the arrangement, **S sits to the immediate right of U.**

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: J, H, Q, S, X, L and I are sitting in a straight line facing south, but not necessarily in the same order. There are two people between J and Q. X is sitting between J and S and is second to the right of H. L is sitting at the second place to the left of Q and to the immediate left of I. Q and H are at the extreme ends of the straight line. Who among the following sits third to the left of J?
questions.solution:
**J, H, Q, S, X, L and I** are sitting in a straight line facing south, but not necessarily in the same order. 

1. X is sitting between J and S and is second to the right of H. 

2. Q and H are at the extreme ends of the straight line.

2. L is sitting at the second place to the left of Q and to the immediate left of I. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4f73444ff5a17f7a425408e7db017726d572342f5f2c798f2f04afd28f9d078.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10627f09441ea82becae48216dfddb9dd4c32048faef75f1b248afaf352cb4cf.png] 

There are two people between J and Q, so case 2 will be eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4f73444ff5a17f7a425408e7db017726d572342f5f2c798f2f04afd28f9d078.png] 

From Case I, H sits third to the left of J.

From the options, we can conclude that H sits third to the left of J.

Hence, '**H**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row on a wall facing towards the west. R is just to the left of S. Q is at one of the end points and T is his neighbour. V is sitting between T and U. S is fifth from the north end. Who among the following persons is sitting exactly in the middle of the row?
questions.solution:
P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a row on a wall facing towards the west.

∴ Here, 'U' is sitting exactly in middle of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "U".**

questions.question: Nine employees, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are sitting in the office in a straight line, all facing the east. O is third to the right of M. K is third to the left of P. Q is immediate between P and S. N is fourth to the right of M. P is to the immediate right of N. R is fourth to the left of O. Which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: L is sitting third to the left of O.
Q is sitting fourth to the right of K.
R and S are sitting at the corners.
O is sitting between K and N.

questions.solution:
Nine employees, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are sitting in the office in a straight line, all facing the east.

1) O is third to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dde0aaf0c77112aa7c88910085bb94f99a988f2168440e96d5a31b41c91cf3e4.png] 

2) N is fourth to the right of M and R is fourth to the left of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/611f09bfa41abd637675eae281112cd886d0b8c84bd9713304c0869a733f2999.png] 

3) P is to the immediate right of N and Q is immediate between P and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5def35465dae6f0d0b05490bd75df3aeb4365ec3a2830266d2a887e743fe0a5f.png] 

4) K is third to the left of P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd0014ad616f0d5bf39328ddda7ea8c64f586313a5cd19c5968d824d961a56d.png] 

Option 1) L is sitting third to the left of O → False (As from the given information **L is Second to the left of O**)

Option 2) Q is sitting fourth to the right of K → True (As from the fourth step of given information Q is sitting fourth to the right of K is true)

Option 3) R and S are sitting at the corners → True (As from the fourth step of given information R and S are sitting at the corners is true)

Option 4) O is sitting between K and N → True (As from the fourth step of given information O is sitting between K and N is true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"L is sitting third to the left of O".**
